summary: keep a plan with an open finding in draft
pull_request_body: The model verification pass finds real defects in a staged plan, yet the plan pull request still goes to review as if it were clean. The stage now keeps such a plan in draft, applies the label `plan/needs-fix`, and puts the open findings at the top of the stage comment. The row `stage_ready` refuses to mark that pull request ready and says why. A plan with an open finding does not count as staged in the round budget: it counts as a failed attempt of class `plan_defect`. The golden set records #3174 as a case of the new stop. No existing gate is removed or weakened.
why: The stage job marks a plan pull request ready when the form gates and CI pass, so a plan whose own model review found a real defect still goes to review as if clean (#3264). The Service's round budget also counts such a plan as staged.
what_changes: The stage keeps a plan pull request in draft when the verification pass returns an open finding, applies the label `plan/needs-fix`, and puts the findings at the top of the stage comment.
The row `stage_ready` refuses to mark a plan pull request ready while `plan/needs-fix` is present, and comments the reason.
A plan with an open finding counts as a failed attempt of class `plan_defect` and not as a staged plan in the round budget.
The golden set gains a case recorded from #3174, replayed by the existing `devops roadmap eval stage` command.
The documentation of the stage job and the roadmap workflow states the open-finding stop.
feasibility: The premise holds: the docstring of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage.py` says "A finding of the type `missing_path`, `false_premise` or `ignores_existing_code` that quotes its evidence sends the plan back to the planner once; every other finding goes into the comment of the item. The review never merges and never marks a draft ready."
`docs/roadmap/stage.md` line 41 confirms it: "Every other finding goes into the comment, and the draft still opens."
The probe `stage_ready` is defined at tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_run.py:882: `stage_ready=recent,` so the row already exists and a refusal there changes existing code.

`read_file` on `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_verify.py` shows `Finding` with `type: DefectType` and the quote check of `returning`; the stage already holds the data that the open-finding stop needs, so no new model call is added. `PullStatus` in `src/devops_cli/github/client.py` adds `labels` so `stage_ready` inspects PR labels.
`src/devops_cli/roadmap/failure.py` is the caller of `plan_defect` and `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_failure.py` tests it, so the budget change reuses that class.

First checks against the real system: `uv run devops ci test tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_stage_verify.py`, `uv run devops ci test tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_stage_verification.py`, `uv run devops ci test tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_run.py`, `uv run devops openspec check`.
existing_tool: No open, maintained tool or library covers this need: the change modifies this repository's own roadmap stage job and `stage_ready` row. It reuses `stage_verify.Finding`, `stage_verify.returning` and `roadmap.failure` instead of new code, which keeps the cost at about 6,000 tokens to build, keep and fix, and about half a day elapsed.

decisions.decision: Detect an open finding from the result of the verification pass, not from the plan text.
decisions.reason: The pass already returns each finding with a quote and a `type: DefectType`, and `returning` already checks the quote against the input, so the stage needs no second model and no text parse.

decisions.decision: Treat a finding as open when its type is one of the four returning defect types (`missing_path`, `false_premise`, `ignores_existing_code`, `spec_delta_wrong`) or reports a placeholder.
decisions.reason: The verification pass classifies findings into `DefectType`; open findings match these defect types or identify placeholder artifacts with evidence quotes.

decisions.decision: Mark an open finding with the label `plan/needs-fix`.
decisions.reason: A label is a stable, queryable marker that a person can remove, and the `plan/` prefix keeps it apart from the `status/*` and `priority/*` families that hold item state.

decisions.decision: Decide the refusal of `stage_ready` from the label, not from the comment text.
decisions.reason: Comment text has no machine-readable contract, and the label survives an edit of the comment.

decisions.decision: Clear the label on a later stage round that returns no open finding.
decisions.reason: A corrected plan then moves on with no person in the loop, and a person can still remove a stale label by hand.

decisions.decision: Record the item as a failed attempt of class `plan_defect` and not as staged.
decisions.reason: `plan_defect` already exists in `src/devops_cli/roadmap/failure.py`, so the round budget names the real cause and spends no budget on a bad plan.

decisions.decision: Put the open findings first in the stage comment, ahead of the plan-run report.
decisions.reason: The reviewer sees the defect before the tool-call and token metrics.

decisions.decision: Add a case recorded from #3174 to the golden set with the defect type `other` and the gate `none`, because no gate of the replay judges the open-finding stop.
decisions.reason: `DefectType` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_eval_cases.py` holds no placeholder type, and a defect for a gate that does not exist yet is listed and not failed.

rejected.alternative: Parse the plan text for `x` or `placeholder` to find a defect.
rejected.evidence: `docs/roadmap/stage.md` line 41 and the docstring of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage.py` show that the verification pass already returns findings with a quote and a kind; a text parse would miss the anchor and duplicate the pass.

rejected.alternative: Add a placeholder value to `DefectType` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_eval_cases.py` and a gate that refuses it.
rejected.evidence: `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_eval_cases.py` holds `DefectType` and `GateName` only, and `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_stage_eval_run.py` holds the set of defect types; the open-finding stop reads the verification result of a model, which the replay makes no call to, so a replay gate could not refuse it.
CONTEXT.md says the Status family holds item state and that a Blocked item waits on something outside the roadmap, which is not a plan defect.

rejected.alternative: Check only the draft state in `stage_ready`.
rejected.evidence: The stage opens every plan as a draft, so the draft state cannot tell a new plan from a plan with an open finding.

rejected.alternative: Keep every finding as a comment only, as today.
rejected.evidence: The issue records #3194 and #3174 staged non-draft with placeholder text, so a comment alone does not stop the pull request.

rejected.alternative: Replace or relax a form gate to make the stop cheap.
rejected.evidence: `docs/adr/0004-ci-is-the-authoritative-gate.md` makes CI the merge gate, and the issue forbids lowering a gate.

modified.name: An open finding keeps the plan in draft
modified.text: When the verification pass returns a finding with a quote in the input and an open defect type (`missing_path`, `false_premise`, `ignores_existing_code`, `spec_delta_wrong` or a placeholder), the stage SHALL keep the plan pull request in draft, apply the label `plan/needs-fix`, and put the findings at the top of the stage comment.

scenarios.name: Placeholder finding from a fake client
scenarios.when: The fake client returns a placeholder finding with a quote that is in the input.
scenarios.then: The plan pull request is a draft, has the `plan/needs-fix` label, and its comment starts with the finding text.

scenarios.name: Finding with no quote in the input
scenarios.when: The client returns a finding whose quote does not match the input.
scenarios.then: The finding is ignored and the plan stages normally.

modified.name: A plan with an open finding is a failed attempt
modified.text: A plan with an open finding SHALL count as a failed attempt of class `plan_defect` in the failure taxonomy and SHALL NOT count as staged in the Service round budget.

scenarios.name: Round budget sees an open finding
scenarios.when: A plan produces an open finding during staging.
scenarios.then: The round budget counts no staged plan and records the attempt as failed.

scenarios.name: Outcome mapping
scenarios.when: The stage records a failed attempt with open findings.
scenarios.then: The failure taxonomy classifies it under `plan_defect`.

modified.name: The Service marks a green stage pull request ready
modified.text: The row `stage_ready` SHALL NOT mark a plan pull request ready while the label `plan/needs-fix` is present, and SHALL post a comment stating that reason once.

scenarios.name: Draft with plan/needs-fix label
scenarios.when: The checks pass and the pull request holds `plan/needs-fix`.
scenarios.then: The pull request stays draft and the row comments the refusal reason.

scenarios.name: Clean draft pull request
scenarios.when: The checks pass and `plan/needs-fix` is absent.
scenarios.then: The row marks the pull request ready.

added.name: The golden set holds a case of the open-finding stop
added.text: The golden set SHALL hold a case recorded from #3174 whose plan carries a single group titled `placeholder`, and the replay SHALL report that case with its defect.

scenarios.name: The replay runs the recorded case
scenarios.when: The replay runs the case recorded from #3174.
scenarios.then: The report lists the case with its placeholder group, and the test asserts the expected result.

criteria.criterion: A test with a fake client that returns a placeholder finding shows that the plan pull request is opened as a draft with the label and the findings in the comment.
A test shows that a plan with no finding is staged as today.
A test shows that the ready row refuses a plan with an open finding, and states why.
The golden-set replay includes #3194 or #3174 as a case.
